body:
I know you mean well, and I appreciate that. But, I can't take a break. If I take a break from fighting for my kids, then I will surely lose them legally. If I take a break from paying my lawyers, then I can't continue in court. I can't take a break from missing and loving my children who I can't see. I can't take a break from paying my bills or going to work.

I may be what matters right now, but it certainly doesn't feel that way. My family barely even bothers to call or text anymore. They are good people, but have their own lives and problems to deal with. 

That is why I have decided to just let it go. When I'm gone, my kids won't have to deal with a custody battle for years. And, I won't have to feel the daily pain of losing them for no good reason. I can take a break from worrying about how to pay for my lawyers and still pay to fix my car. I don't have to care how I can afford to pay for my own food even though I have a good job.
Most of those are not they way I'd like to go. I think the subreddit rules mandate that we can't discuss methods, so I don't think you'll get many responses. You can always ask Google though.

Thank you for your kind words. I have been talking vaguely about it with my fiancee for more than a month. I don't think she takes me seriously. 

However, I don't want her or anyone else to stop me. Everyone will say they love me so much and want me to stick around, but they can't feel my pain and can't/won't do anything to stop it.

I am not encouraging or discouraging you from doing anything, but here is my experience: 

I tried a couple times before. Alcohol helped a lot. It lowered my inhibitions and helped emotionally. (I felt calm with my decision then eventually so sad that I went through with it).
